verdict.rationale: QuickBooks advertises automatic expense sorting (quickbooks-docs-28) and community evidence confirms rule-based automatic categorization exists in QBO (quickbooks-comm-3), but no evidence describes a system that learns from user corrections over time as opposed to static bank rules. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of ML-based suggestion refinement from user corrections, first-party detail on the categorization algorithm, and independent confirmation that suggestions improve after corrections.
